title: Strict quotient-cone augmentation is the derived adjoint
statement: Let phi:R -> S be a morphism of commutative ring sheaves on an essentially small site, with the independent coefficient conventions and derived categories. Let t be a global section of R, d a cochain derived scalar-extension model, and b a normalized regular quotient cone augmentation [lem-cbc-regular-quotient-cone-augmentation]. For a complex P of R-modules, a complex N of S-modules, and a strict map f:P -> Res(N) annihilating t, the restriction of the derived adjoint of Q(f), under b.adjunction and b.restriction_factor, is b.A inverse followed by b.cone_factor, Q of the zero-nullhomotopy cone descent (0,f), and the inverse restriction factor. This equation is natural for arbitrary unbounded P and needs no fullness of derived restriction.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A6; normalized tensor adjunction on K-flat resolutions

proof.text: The normalized ordinary coefficient adjunction has unit equal to b.rho, since their section formulas both send x to the sheafified 1 tensor x. Transpose f to g with this adjunction.

For K-flat P, b.unit_normalization identifies the derived adjoint with its universal cochain counit followed by Q(g). The formula for b.A and b.a_components then identifies its restriction with the cone descent having shifted component zero and unshifted component f.

For arbitrary P resolve by a K-flat K. Precompose by the invertible derived tensor image of Q(K -> P). Naturality of b.A, b.cone_factor and the adjunction reduces both sides to the K-flat identity; on cone coordinates the final equality is strict.

theorem augmentation_adjoint
    (P : CochainComplex (Modules R) ℤ) (N : CochainComplex (Modules S) ℤ)
    (f : P ⟶ ((restriction φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N)
    (hf : (complexScalar R t).app P ≫ f = 0) :
    b.V.map ((b.adjunction.homEquiv (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)).symm
      (DerivedCategory.Q.map f ≫ b.restriction_factor.inv.app N)) =
      b.A.inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ b.cone_factor.hom.app P ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.desc
          ((complexScalar R t).app P) 0 f (by simp [hf])) ≫
        b.restriction_factor.inv.app N
